description: This file declares interfaces for managing WPA supplicant configurations, including functions for loading, creating, deleting, writing, and modifying configuration parameters for WPA networks.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_loadConfig
methods.description: Loads WPA supplicant configuration from a specified file path.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_createConfig
methods.description: Creates an empty WPA supplicant configuration structure.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_deleteConfig
methods.description: Deletes a WPA supplicant configuration structure.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_writeConfig
methods.description: Writes the WPA supplicant configuration to a specified file path.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_addConfigParam
methods.description: Adds a key-value parameter to the WPA supplicant configuration.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_delConfigParam
methods.description: Deletes a specific key parameter from the configuration.
